corrected_text: On macOS 15/iOS 18 and later the LiteRT accelerator's GpuBackendMetal creates an MTLResidencySet ('LiteRT Model Residency Set') and adds constants, external immutable tensors and every bound tensor to it, but attaches it to the queue, requests residency and starts a 100 ms re-request heartbeat thread only when residency is enabled; LiteRT-LM passes AdvancedSettings.gpu_enable_metal_residency_set (default false) in the compilation options and in the run options of the main executor's prefill and decode runs on Apple (the MTP drafter and verify runs pass none), Invoke applies it whenever a run carries GPU options, and Agello doesn't set it, so in Agello the set is never requested.

corrected_text: Agello's CanCopyLinearBufferDirect (LiteRT e17213ea/584f3461) allows a direct host copy when the tensor has kBuffer or kImageBuffer storage, its data type equals the host element type (FP16, FP32, INT8, UINT8, INT16, UINT16, INT32 or UINT32), its MTLBuffer uses MTLStorageModeShared, and its BHWDC element count times element byte size equals the host byte size; writes to a kLinear-layout tensor also require TensorDescriptor::GetElementSize() (channels per slice) to be 4, which always holds for buffer storage.
